description: LICHEN CCP slot assignment with SFN wraparound test vectors (spec section 14.7). Tests slot_for(eui64, sfn, num_slots) = ((hash_32(eui64) + (sfn & 0xFFFFFFFF)) & 0xFFFFFFFF) % num_slots and sfn_delta(curr, last) = (curr - last) & 0xFFFFFFFF. Critical for ensuring slot rotation continues correctly across the SFN u32 wrap boundary in every implementation.

vectors.name: hash_32_reference
vectors.description: Reference hash_32 value for EUI64 0x0102030405060708, used by subsequent slot tests

vectors.name: slot_for_sfn_zero
vectors.description: Slot assignment at SFN=0, baseline for rotation tests

vectors.name: slot_for_sfn_one
vectors.description: Slot assignment at SFN=1, verifies SFN increments slot by 1

vectors.name: slot_for_sfn_max
vectors.description: Slot assignment at SFN=0xFFFFFFFF (max u32), just before wrap

vectors.name: slot_for_wrapping_sum_before_non_power_of_two_modulus
vectors.description: The u32 addition must wrap before a non-power-of-two slot modulus; masking only SFN gives the wrong slot.

vectors.name: slot_for_sfn_after_wrap
vectors.description: Slot assignment at SFN=2, just after wrap from 0xFFFFFFFF

vectors.name: sfn_wrap_continuity
vectors.description: Slot continuity across SFN wrap: slot at max+3 equals slot at 2 (since delta=3)

vectors.name: sfn_mask_to_32bit
vectors.description: SFN values above 2^32 must mask to 32 bits before calculation

vectors.name: sfn_mask_large_value
vectors.description: Large SFN value masks correctly

vectors.name: sfn_delta_wrap_minimal
vectors.description: Smallest SFN wrap: 0 - 0xFFFFFFFF = 1 in unsigned 32-bit

vectors.name: sfn_delta_wrap_multi
vectors.description: SFN wrap from 0xFFFFFFFF to 2: delta=3

vectors.name: sfn_delta_wrap_near
vectors.description: Near-wrap SFN delta: curr=5, last=0xFFFFFFFE yields delta=7

vectors.name: sfn_delta_no_wrap
vectors.description: Normal delta without wrap

vectors.description: Same SFN yields zero delta

vectors.name: sfn_delta_large_forward
vectors.description: Large forward jump within 32-bit range

vectors.name: sfn_delta_apparent_backward
vectors.description: Apparent backward jump (curr < last) wraps to large positive

vectors.description: Slot with num_slots=8 (smaller slot space)
